verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a documentation framework, and docs tooling can plausibly ship analytics, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about analytics at all, let alone separating AI-agent traffic from human readers. The pluggable architecture and swizzling are generic developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my docs analytics distinguish AI-agent traffic from human traffic so I can see who — or what — is actually reading
